evidence.quote: We show that hot gas with chromospheric characteristics exists around the star. Its filling factor is shown to be small.

claims.hypothesis: Does hot chromospheric gas with small filling factor exist around W Hya?
claims.experiment: Resolved 338 GHz continuum, visibility fitting of disk and hotspots
claims.result: Unresolved hotspot with Tb >5.3x10^4 K, area filling factor <0.2%
claims.finding: Shock-heated hot gas with small filling factor exists

evidence.quote: this means that the true brightness temperature of the spot is > 5.3x10 4 K, consistent with the temperature expected in a strong shock

claims.hypothesis: Is there a warm molecular layer plus infall/outflow in the atmosphere?
claims.experiment: Radiative transfer modelling of CO v=1 J=3-2 spectra
claims.result: Warm layer ~2900 K, cool layers 850-900 K, infall/outflow ~±20 km/s
claims.finding: Warm molecular layer and fast infall/outflow, in conflict with models

evidence.quote: Thus, although the fits are, in most cases, not statistically distinguishable when fitting the entire spectrum, the models including a warm layer produce improved fits.

claims.finding: Post-shock cooling time cannot be instantaneous

evidence.quote: Our observations now show that the cooling time cannot be instantaneous.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Models with equal gas temperature in the two hemispheres tested; derived values differ ~10% and ~5%

evidence.quote: We find that the derived temperatures and densities are different by only ~10% and ~5% with respect to the previous models.

limitations_admitted.value: SO2 identification of the emission line is tentative

evidence.quote: we also cannot rule out that the emission originates from a different, unidentified, molecular or atomic transition.

limitations_admitted.value: Choice of one component per quadrant is arbitrary; degeneracies prevent constraining surface structure

evidence.quote: the choice of a single component per quadrant is arbitrary and only serves to highlight that more than a single component is needed to describe the data.
